description: A manufacturing engineering director must authorize and configure a pilot run of recycled aluminum alloy for enclosure production on Press 3, finalizing the quantity, inspection, maintenance, and scrap-handling controls with input from quality, process engineering, maintenance, and environmental health and safety.

shared_context.S1: Press 3 is available for a controlled pilot using recycled aluminum alloy supplied in two identified billet lots.
shared_context.S2: The pilot is intended to produce enclosure housings for an engineering evaluation before any routine production approval.
shared_context.S3: Maya has authority to approve the pilot configuration and its required controls.
shared_context.S4: The normal pre-pilot review includes a round of input from quality, process engineering, maintenance, and environmental health and safety before the configuration is released.

PF1.text: Leon confirmed in the customer's pilot control plan that all pilot housings require a 100% conductivity test and that 24 housings must be retained for evaluation; the plan was received in yesterday's customer portal update but has not yet been uploaded to the internal work order.

PF2.text: Priya's process trial confirmed that each furnace charge can produce at most 240 acceptable housings from this recycled alloy, and each charge requires a 2-hour preheat; her test note is still awaiting materials-review signoff.

PF3.text: Owen's inspection found a cracked insert in Press 3's enclosure die that must be replaced before the pilot, and the replacement and verification require exactly 5 hours of downtime; he has not yet entered the finding in the maintenance scheduling system.

PF4.text: Sofia's permit review found that recycled-alloy fines must be collected in exactly 2 sealed scrap bins and transferred under a waste manifest; she received the clarification from the environmental permitting office this morning but has not amended the area permit board.

acceptance_conditions: The pilot must be configured for exactly 480 housings.
Every pilot housing must receive a conductivity test and exactly 24 housings must be retained.
Each furnace charge must have a 2-hour preheat.
The cracked die insert must be replaced with exactly 5 hours of maintenance downtime.
Exactly 2 sealed scrap bins and a waste manifest must be included in the scrap-handling controls.
The customer control-plan finding must be cited by the decision-maker.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'die_replacement' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'waste_manifest' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The customer control plan changes the inspection from an ordinary pilot sample to 100% conductivity testing and changes the retained-sample count to exactly 24.
The process trial changes the authorized pilot quantity to exactly 480 housings from two 240-housing charges and sets the preheat duration at exactly 2 hours per charge.
The cracked insert changes the equipment plan to a required replacement with exactly 5 hours of downtime and requires a die-replacement commitment.
The permit clarification changes scrap handling to exactly 2 sealed bins with a required waste manifest and requires a waste-manifest commitment.
